text:
maria: Quick sync — following the postmortem for last night's missing-span + bad-aggregation incident (https://redwood.internal/postmortem/INC-2026-03). I want to confirm owners, timelines, and which items need backfills vs config fixes. Can folks call out what they're taking?

ashwin: I can take the ETL windowing rewrite (the job currently drops late manifests). Target: end of week for a draft PR. I'll add unit + integration tests. :white_check_mark:

jordan: I'll own metrics reconciliation and the aggregation regression tests. ETA 2 weeks. Also proposing a lightweight canary run before full rollout — any objections?

elaine: I can do alert tuning and runbook updates (oncall playbook + pager thresholds). Will open the PR by Thu.

maria: Great. I'll create a tracking board and assign owners. @sre-bot please create a recurring follow-up reminder (fortnightly) for remediation progress checks.

sre-bot: Created reminder in #obs-remediations: cadence=2w, next_run=1759973143 (2026-04-08). Assigned reminder recipients: maria, ashwin, jordan, elaine.

ashwin: Quick note — the lag looks like an S3 manifest race where out-of-order manifests cause the ETL to miss a window. Repro steps I'm adding to the ticket: `aws s3 cp --recursive s3://obs-raw/manifests/ ./test-manifests` then reorder files to simulate delay. I'll add an integration test that injects delayed manifests.

jordan: I reproduced the aggregation discrepancy locally using the trace fixture (trace_id: f2c3...) — PR with test and failing case: https://review.internal/r/4321 (WIP).

elaine: Question — do we need to backfill missing spans for the last 24h for critical customers, or can the aggregation fix suffice without backfill? If backfill, who will run it and what's the resource estimate?

maria: Good question. Minimal backfill for 1 affected customer only. @ashwin can you scope run time and infra needs by EOD today? If it's >12h, we may need infra support.

ashwin: Will scope by EOD — initial guess: small run (2-3 nodes) for ~6 hours, but will confirm.

jordan: Also flagging a recurring pattern: span loss spikes during high-concurrency deploys. Action: add a post-deploy validation step that verifies span ingress rates vs baseline for 15m. Owner: jordan + eng-runtime. Target: include in next release (r27).

maria: Added action item: post-deploy validation. Owners: jordan / eng-runtime. Target: r27.

elaine: I'll update runbooks to include the post-deploy validation and backfill play.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll update the postmortem with owners, tickets, and deadlines, and attach the tracking board. Closing this thread for now — we'll reconvene on the fortnightly check. :thumbsup:
